body.title: Verify recovery, compatibility and deployable timeout behavior
body.summary: Add end-to-end deterministic regressions for both adapters and routes, preserved bounded provider calls, result durability, cancellation/resource cleanup and removed review boundary invariants. Document new activity contract and internal diagnostic limits; build and retain test evidence without paid model/full repository sweeps.
acceptanceChecks: Fake-time tests cover long progress, exactly 30-minute inactivity, long silent tools, local-pressure/unknown diagnostics and delayed event-loop wake
Both native CLI fixture streams cover valid feedback then crash, candidate-expiry race, write failure, malformed frames, bounded output and group cleanup
Current checkpoint/CR history and explicit resume remain valid; unrelated bounded Ollama/CLI tests and retired exception tests pass
Production build and focused relevant suites pass; test evidence distinguishes deterministic fixtures from live model proof
Handoff exposes normalized activity for separate STORY-e6ddcdcb3d9cf330-s4 without implementing its presentation or the future design-review epic

tests.name: End-to-end deterministic recovery: two CLI adapters/routes, silent tools/local-pressure/unknown telemetry, no repeated completed task
Production build plus focused task-review, provider, IPC and retired-boundary regression suites; no paid/live or full repository sweep
